  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public SecuritycurrencyIndicatorGroup calculate(SecuritycurrencyGroup group, Integer tenant, LocalDate today)
      Computes the indicator cells of one watchlist group. The columns of the tenant that apply to the watchlist are evaluated through evaluate(List, List, Integer, LocalDate) and the result is copied into the group together with its presentation data.

    • evaluate

      public IndicatorBatch evaluate(List<? extends Securitycurrency<?>> instruments, List<WatchlistIndicatorColumn> columns, Integer idTenant, LocalDate today)
      Loads the quote series, dividends, fundamentals and benchmarks that the given columns need and evaluates every column for every instrument. The columns are evaluated as passed; their watchlist assignment is not applied here. Used by the watchlist indicator tab and by the advanced security search, which therefore share one loading and one evaluation pass. Prices are the stored last prices of the instruments; no price update is triggered.
      Parameters:
      instruments - the securities and currency pairs to evaluate
      columns - the indicator columns to evaluate, not empty
      idTenant - the tenant that authorises the benchmarks of the columns
      today - the day of the evaluation, in the calendar of the client
      Returns:
      the cells and the information that the indicator tab shows around them
